title: CAN-SPAM Unsubscribe Rules: 10 Business Days, Not One Click
meta_description: CAN-SPAM wants a working opt-out in every email, live for 30 days and honored within 10 business days. One-click is Google’s and Yahoo’s bulk sender rule.
secondary_keywords: how long to honor unsubscribe request

image.takeaway: CAN-SPAM allows 10 business days to honor an unsubscribe. One click is a Gmail and Yahoo rule.
image.alt: CAN-SPAM unsubscribe rules: the law wants a working opt-out in every commercial email, live for 30 days and honored within 10 business days, while one-click unsubscribe is a Google and Yahoo bulk sender rule

chart.title: Days to stop emailing after an unsubscribe
chart.subtitle: Gmail: 48 hours. Yahoo: 2 days. The three laws count business days.
chart.source: Sources: Google, Yahoo, LII, Justice Laws Canada, AustLII, October 2026.
chart.alt: Bar chart of how many days a sender has to stop emailing someone who unsubscribes: 2 days (48 hours) for Gmail bulk senders, 2 days for Yahoo bulk senders, 5 business days under Australia’s Spam Act, 10 business days under the US CAN-SPAM Act and 10 business days under Canada’s CASL
